Buy the course, €149 Lifetime access, one payment Level All levels Lessons 9 Duration 3 h 10 min Includes Video and working files (About the course) Most shoots I direct have one photographer, one day and no room for a second attempt. This course is about making that day count. It is built around the serum campaign in my portfolio, from the first brief to the final crops, including the frames that did not make it and why. What you will be able to do 01 Write a one-page brief a photographer can shoot from 02 Plan a day that ends with forty usable frames 03 Direct people and products with confidence on set 04 Pick, retouch and deliver images for every format (Curriculum) 01 Before the shoot 3 lessons, 1 h 1.1 The one-page brief 22 min 1.2 Casting and locations 20 min 1.3 Shot lists 18 min 02 On set 3 lessons, 1 h 7 min 2.1 Working with
